footprint_note: Stations with no mapped entrance carry an OSM building/platform footprint hull. The entrance lies on or near it, so a walk to its nearest edge is too short by at most span_m.
estimate_note: Entrances marked estimated: found by rule H (entrance=yes/main, ticket validator or lift within 60 m of the station outline). Tested on 36 stations with known entrances: 96% of real entrances within 40 m, median miss 5 m, p90 25 m. Extra uncertainty 40 m.
